name: Announcement bar
definition: Thin full-width strip above the header with one short message, a link and a dismiss button.
bestUse: Time-bound news such as a launch, an event or a policy change.

demo.how: One sentence and one link sit above the header, where every visitor sees them without blocking the page. The close button removes the bar and the header moves up; Reset brings it back, as a returning visitor would see it again after a new announcement. The message is illustrative.
